text:
Raj P.: Passing Celestia (mid-market trial) to CS. Quick context: 50k tokens/day observed in PoC, evaluating Dedicated vs Hosted, requires Okta SSO, HIPAA concerns flagged. Trial ends in 10 days. Provisioning partially done — staging VPC created but customer can't hit API due to IP allowlist. Renewal at risk if connectivity/perf not met. Owner: Raj.

Sarah C.: Got it, thanks. I'll own onboarding. Tagging eng/support for IP allowlist + VPC routing. CS checklist: confirm SSO mapping, finish provisioning, schedule onboarding call, collect sample prompts, document perf targets.

Jenny S.: Can you drop the provisioning manifest and the customer's network contact? Also need exact IPs we gave to share with their team.

Raj P.: Customer network lead: maria@celestia.ai. IPs we provided: 52.14.100.23, 52.14.101.44. Staging cluster id: stg-cel-02. Provisioning snippet below:
```
customer_id: C-98765
env: staging
vpc: vpc-0a1b2c
allowed_ips:
 - 52.14.100.23
 - 52.14.101.44
```

Mike L.: Quick perf note: we're seeing KV cache misses since they're sending long-context queries (~8k tokens). Recommend a medium-large instance and enabling prefix caching/prefetch. I'll propose instance profile and fallback model. @eng-oncall-bot can we schedule a small capacity bump tomorrow morning?

eng-oncall-bot: Scheduled: capacity bump for stg-cel-02 at 09:00 PT tomorrow. Infra pager notified.

Sarah C.: Next steps (owners): 1) Jenny to confirm IP allowlist with customer (support) 2) Mike to propose instance/quantization profile + infra ticket (eng) 3) I will run CS kickoff, share enablement deck and collect 10 eval prompts (CS). Please update owners in the ticketing system.

Raj P.: CS success criteria from customer: median token latency <1s for short prompts, 95th percentile <2s, and parity with redwood-hosted model outputs for their clinical summarization tests. They also want help curating prompt sets for clinical summarization.

Jenny S.: Reach out to maria now. ETA to whitelist once they confirm: EOD today is likely. Will paste confirmation here.

Sarah C.: Also need to capture feedback during onboarding: 10 initial evaluation prompts + expected outputs. I'll create a shared doc (Drive) and tag you both.

Mike L.: For quantization: recommend int8 + selective 4-bit hybrid for longer layers to save memory. Propose model variant 'redwood-2-small-quant' for staging. Opening infra ticket #CS-1279 with config details.

Raj P.: Flagging renewal risk: set account health renewal_risk=high if perf/SLA not met by trial end. Renewal date: 2025-06-15. If we don't hit perf targets, they're likely to push to competitor.

Sarah C.: Noted. I'll set renewal_risk=high in the account dashboard and start weekly check-ins. Also request: can CS get read-only logs access for troubleshooting for the first 72h post-connect?

Jenny S.: Yes — support will grant read-only logs once IPs are confirmed and ACLs updated.

eng-oncall-bot: Infra ticket created: #INF-8421. Owner: Mike L. ETA: 24h.

Sarah C.: Scheduling kickoff call for tomorrow 10:30 PT. Invite sent to maria@celestia.ai, raj, mike, jenny. Agenda: network connect verification, perf targets, SSO mapping, eval prompt list, next steps.

Raj P.: :thumbsup: Appreciate the fast turnaround. Anything else we should flag?

Mike L.: One more: enable KV prefetching for their most common prompt prefixes to reduce cold-token cost. I'll add this as a config change in the infra ticket.

Jenny S.: Whitelist confirmed by customer network at 16:40 PT. Added to staging ACLs. @Sarah C. can you confirm connectivity from their side during kickoff?

Sarah C.: Confirmed they can connect, testing now. Initial tests look good. I'll run through the enablement deck and capture feedback in the shared doc. Will post follow-up notes in this thread.

Sarah C.: Follow-up: initial run shows median token latency ~0.9s for short prompts, tail ~1.8s. CS action: collect 10 target examples plus expected outputs from customer; will attach to shared doc. Also capturing product feedback: request for more clinical summarization examples and guidance on hallucination thresholds.

Raj P.: Thanks team — marking sales->CS handoff complete. CS->eng/support handoff items are owned as listed. Please update account health dashboard, tag renewal risk, and close loop on infra ticket when config changes deploy.
